value.rationale: The result gives an exact all-n iteration benchmark for the simplest connected regular graphs where 1-WL is powerless, sharpening a broad circulant O(d(n) log n) bound to a closed form and explaining it by a structural distance-doubling invariant. The simultaneous counting-width transition at n=6 is a natural finite-model-theory boundary.
